links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient education texts on hypertension with CKD (FRES, SMOG)
links.effect: Median FRES 20.53 and SMOG 16.36, indicating substantial reading burden; Perplexity showed greatest reading burden, DeepSeek-V3.2 lowest.
links.quote: FRES and SMOG were 20.53 and 16.36, indicating limited actionability, poor source transparency, and substantial reading burden.

links.outcome: Comprehensibility (readability, understandability, actionability) of LLM patient education outputs
links.effect: Median PEMAT-P understandability 69.20 but actionability 20.00; high reading burden (FRES 20.53, SMOG 16.36).
links.quote: Under standardized English prompts, large language model-generated patient education texts for hypertension with chronic kidney disease showed relatively good understandability but limited actionability and source transparency, while overall reading burden remained high.

screen.reason: Evaluates 12 LLMs for generating patient education materials on hypertension and chronic kidney disease using standard readability and quality metrics without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
